sections.content: Mutual fund investors have the right to receive: Consolidated Account Statement (CAS) within 10 days of month-end; Redemption or repurchase proceeds dispatched within T+2 business days from the date of redemption request; Dividend (IDCW) payouts within 7 working days from the record date; and grievance redressal via SCORES within 21 calendar days.

AMCs must disclose monthly portfolio statements within 10 days of month-end, annual financial reports within 4 months of year-end, and unhedged derivative positions. Investors have the right to inspect trust deeds, AMC agreements, and KIMs.
